assets.name: Murmur messenger
assets.description: Rounded bubbles, outgoing right in accent, thin header with the artist name as contact, abstract avatar disc. Original design language: rounded-rect geometry on an 8 px grid, the style's neutral ramps, one accent; invented names; no real iconography.
assets.purpose: Messaging home for SCR-SCN-01 and 05 replies. Each kit is a kind of writing, which is the main variation axis of the style (Phase 1 E.1).
assets.references: Screenlife films (Phase 1 B.39) for camera and typing as character; existing Code screens camera grammar (terminal.ts, screens.ts on the PR #5 branch). Method only: no real app chrome, icons or brand colours.
assets.format: JSON layout spec (widgets, metrics, text styles) painted at runtime to a canvas sheet; icons as inline SVG path data (original).
assets.dimensions: Layout in device points (phone 390x844 pt, tablet 820x1180, laptop 1440x900, terminal 80x24 cells); painted at 2x into sheets up to 2048 px.
assets.layer_structure: Opaque sheet per state; active field drawn as a separate overlay quad so the caret and lyric update without repainting.
assets.animation: Static sheet; reactive overlays (field, caret, bubbles).
assets.colour_behaviour: Theme ramps fixed; accent palette-driven from cover.
assets.scene_compatibility: Per kit (see member detail); all kits support C1 and C2.
assets.asset_compatibility: Device frames of the matching class; typing profiles; notifications of the same device world.
assets.exclusion_rules: Never two kits of different OS design languages in one song; terminal kits never with stickers.
assets.responsive_behaviour: Kit layouts are responsive by device class, not by output aspect: the camera adapts framing.
assets.performance: One sheet per state, 2-8 MB each at 2x; painted once and cached in the LRU (pinned while the scene is active).
assets.acceptance_criteria: Reads as a believable original app at a glance; passes the brand-likeness review; lyric field contrast 4.5:1; all states painted in dark and light themes; RTL mirror correct.
assets.variations_not_counted: Dark and light themes and accent recolours are parameters, not separate assets.

assets.name: Bedroom at night

assets.layer_structure: Background shapes, practical light, bokeh layer; all opaque.
assets.animation: Slow drift and bokeh breathing; per-plate events (passing headlights).
assets.colour_behaviour: Tinted by theme spill; practical light hue from cover temperature.
assets.scene_compatibility: C1, C5 and scene families listed per member.
assets.asset_compatibility: Phones, tablets, laptops; not CRT (CRT uses its own dark room).
assets.exclusion_rules: Never two practical lights of different temperatures in one plate.
assets.responsive_behaviour: Each plate declares a focal light position; portrait crops keep the light in frame.
assets.performance: One 1024x576 texture, under 2.4 MB.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Reads as a place in deep blur; no object identifiable enough to raise rights questions; light direction matches the declared focal light.
